title: Vanishing, support and (S_2) properties of the dualizing module over a local base
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: For X over A with omega_X^bullet and omega_X as in Example labelled example-proper-over-local, the lemma asserts four properties: the cohomology of omega_X^bullet vanishes outside {-dim(X), ..., 0}; the support of H^i(omega_X^bullet) has dimension at most -i; the support of omega_X is the union of the components of dimension dim(X); and omega_X has property (S_2) (statement lines 6124-6154). Letting delta_X and delta_S be the dimension functions of Lemma labelled lemma-good-dualizing-dimension-function, the proof uses that X proper over A makes every closed subscheme contain a closed point x mapping to the closed point s of S with delta_X(x) = delta_S(s) = 0, so delta_X(xi) = dim of the closure of xi for every point xi (proof lines 6156-6164). Hence each statement can be checked over Spec(O_{X,x}), where it follows from Dualizing Complexes, Lemmas labelled dualizing-lemma-sitting-in-degrees and dualizing-lemma-depth-dualizing-module, with some details omitted; the last two statements can also be deduced from Lemma labelled lemma-dualizing-module (proof lines 6164-6172). Normalising the dimension function at closed points so that the local statements apply is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2; the omitted details are recorded verbatim in the notes.
